CustomField.description: THE MEETING TITLE AS THE SOURCE SYSTEM RECORDED IT, carried verbatim and never inferred. Written by: intake, where the source system supplies one (Teams and Gong both do). Read by: AAO_Cards.sectionTitle, which titles a call's board section "Date: Meeting Title". Matthew's ruling, fifty-seventh stamp: the call type comes from the meeting title rather than from a model reading the transcript, because the source system already knows it and inferring a call type would be a judgment nobody asked for on a customer-visible column heading. BLANK IS HONEST AND EXPECTED: a hand-carried paste carries no metadata, and the section then titles by date alone, which is the ruled fallback. Nothing derives this field from the transcript, ever.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The meeting title from the source system (Teams, Gong), carried verbatim. Blank where the source carried none; the board section then titles by date alone.
CustomField.label: Meeting Title
